purpose: Frozen enhanced frontend accuracy validation after mechanism activation; no parameter search
selection: First contiguous 240-frame window after the earlier seq09 frontend window 0..239; fixed before enhanced scoring
taxonomy: native nuScenes16, archived top1 label/confidence; field values are historical class-vote frequencies, not recovered logits
scope: Cached semantic labels with original point identity and identical IMU/image timestamps. Six arms x three repeats, rotated execution order. Geometry shares the preprocessing fix and middleware with enhanced. GT read only after all trajectories hash-frozen.

gate.coverage: all 18 trajectories finite with identical timestamps
gate.mechanism: categorical rows active on at least 80% of updates in every likelihood-only and enhanced run; all boundary rows zero
gate.primary: enhanced_B0 versus geometry: all three paired ATE differences negative, nonoverlapping ATE ranges, mean 1s translation and rotation RPE no worse
gate.increment: apply the same comparison separately to enhanced_B0 versus association_B0; report without hiding regressions
gate.motion: report measured motion/mask activation; do not assume dynamic objects exist in an unseen window
gate.failure: preserve all arms, repetitions and failures; no GT-guided changes to estimator, no winner selection
gate.scope: a pass applies only to this short window; no automatic large experiment

shared_input_fix: Initialize/recompute upstream blind_sqr from blind in all arms; an uninitialized threshold was exposed by the integration fixture. This is a new shared baseline, not a replay of the old estimator.
independence: Unseen by enhanced frontend diagnostics and scoring; not a globally unseen dataset, since historical segmentation/offline mapping used this sequence
